records.name: Otto Inksuction
records.biography_en: Otto grips loose objects around HyperNorm airlocks. The one thing he never holds is the door for management.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He sighed. Three of the suction cups sighed with him.

records.name: Vera Shardtip
records.biography_en: Vera filed the crystal growth as a structural change to her person. HyperNorm returned the form as unauthorized development.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The crystals were quite hard. Her objection was harder to hear.

records.name: Len Roundagain
records.biography_en: Len keeps a register of the things that orbit HyperNorm. The ring is technically a reminder to stay on topic.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He asked if we had met. We had, on the other side.

records.name: Sid Beamcheck
records.biography_en: Sid was lifted from the evacuation queue before his number was called. HyperNorm logged his absence as orderly progress.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The saucer was efficient. The complaint is still on the ground.

records.name: Iris Moonroot
records.biography_en: Iris planted the one thing HyperNorm had authorized to wax and wane. It now leans toward the unapproved light.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: She waters it by the calendar. The plant has retained counsel.

records.name: Bert Frosthaul
records.biography_en: Bert was told to put a comet sample on ice. He took the instruction literally and is still waiting for someone to take it from him.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The sample was immaculately preserved. Its handler was nearing the same condition.
